parsed.reason: The message states facts flatly without any first-person attribution showing Hale looked them up. Phrases like "Sunnyside Splash Pad is on Friday" and "Registration for all of that opens at 6:30" present information as bare statements indistinguishable from trivia. There is no verb of finding or checking ("I found," "I checked," "I looked up") in the lead sentence or anywhere that anchors the facts to work Hale already performed for this family. The opening "Great news!" is a greeting/brand positioning rather than attribution of a search. The closing question "Want me to keep an eye on all of this for you?" is promotional hype about a future service, not evidence of a past look already taken.
